title: Essential Singularity of the Correlation Length in the Planar XY Model
main_claim: For the nearest-neighbour cosine XY model on Z^2 with free-box axis mass m(b), lim_{b->b_c^-} sqrt(b_c-b) log(1/m(b)) = A_XY in (0,inf), with A_XY = (log L) pi / sqrt(3P), where P>0 is the linear temperature response of the critical activity trajectory.

issues.location: sections/entry.tex, Prop. map / Prop. readouts / Prop. critical
issues.description: The quadratic map, its error bounds, the readout multipliers and the critical asymptotics (x_j,y_j)=(1,1)/j+O(log j/j^2) are imported from companion [F] (and a=8pi and the free-height theorems from [X]). I checked that they are used consistently: the normalization x=b_*u, y=sqrt(b_*H)Z turns -H Z^2, -b_* uZ into (x-y^2, y-xy), and kappa=a*g follows from <cos,A cos>=2n^2 sin^2(pi/n). I did not re-audit the companion estimates themselves. This is a dependency, not a demonstrated gap.
issues.evidence: 'The exact activity map and its uniform norm bounds are [F, Proposition 4.1]; ... [F, Lemma 5.2] give leading scalar terms -H_jZ^2 and -b_juZ'

issues.location: sections/entry.tex, proof of Prop. entry (complex majorant and two-constants step)
issues.description: The analytic extension of the entry activities to |b-b_c|<c s^{-2} uses three ingredients: a real-parameter bound with a small per-item factor, a coarse complex bound e^{C l(pi)}, and the two-constants theorem on half-disks. The Poisson majorant |e^{-b}(b/2)^k| <= e^{b_+-Re b} e^{-b_+}(b_+/2)^k and N_pi <= C l s^2 do check out. The real-parameter moment tolerances for the mark fractions d_i are asserted to carry over from [F, Eqs. (75)-(80)] by finite-volume continuity; I could not verify these independently.
issues.evidence: 'Lemma finite-perturbation, applied to these finite graphs, preserves the required tolerances when |b-b_c|<=c_{R_0}s^{-2}.'

coverage:
I read all of introduction, finite.tex (comparisons, factorial insertions, finite perturbation, temperature-response lemma), trajectory.tex, mass.tex, profile.tex lines 1-470 and 1030-1369, and entry.tex (entry proof, map, readouts, grid and cutoff lemmas, critical histories). I skimmed the pinned band/cable part of profile.tex (lines 470-1030). Checks done by hand:
- Flow and invariant: X=k cot(kw), Y=k csc(kw) solve X'=-Y^2, Y'=-XY. The invariant X^2-Y^2=-3P follows from X=1/w-Pw, Y=1/w+Pw/2, giving k^2=3P and T=pi/k.
- Linearization: M=[[0,-2],[-1,-1]] has eigenpairs (1,-1/2)->1 and (1,1)->-2. The dyadic products are 2 and 1/4.
- Weighted forward/backward slaving estimates: r^{1/2}e^gamma<1 holds, and 2/C_*+2gamma<(-log r)/4 holds, from the parameter choices.
- Secant/derivative Cauchy error: eps*rho_J^{-2}=J^4 exp((-3/C_*+4gamma)J)->0. Also checked s/n_i<=e^{-ci} from C_* log L>1000, and that 1/delta=s^{3/2}=o(s^2).
- Variation-of-constants error budget (log J/J + eta^2).
- Exit cone recursion: q_+=(q+y)/(1+qy). Checked the reciprocal-sum exit time and delta*j_e->T.
- Temperature-response lemma: score identity, removal identities E[(U_e-V_e)X]=b r_e v_e, and the Cauchy-Schwarz lower bound.
- Readout multiplier kappa=a*g with g=1/(8pi^2), and the sign argument giving P>0 (variance increases with x).
- Profile: cut monotonicity; ratio exponent 2-a_*/(4pi) from radial energy (1/2pi) log G; Fatou/telescoping exclusion of intermediate values; subexponential critical bound.
- Mass section: Ginibre/Ising-sign supermultiplicativity, C^(2)<=4C, the loop-covariance bound with the Poisson tail, n m >= n^{eta/2w} in the lower bound, annulus count q=(v-u)/(w' log 4), circulation constant D=2pi*int chi/r dr, Hölder cell reduction, and the Lieb-Rivasseau iteration with 8r*r^{-K}<1/2.
- Final conversion to A_XY=pi log L/sqrt(3P).
